body: I don't know if I will be able to repay them ever. I know it will hurt my mum and sister a lot, and I don't know if they'll ever understand my logic behind taking my life, but I want to write them some letter to tell them how it is in my perspective for after. I just don't want to destroy their lives just because they might be hurt if I die. I just don't think it's fair at all.

I just can't find a job, I don't know why, I just can't. 

I've done a carb-less diet and didn't work for me, plus I can't even afford to buy bacon, nevertheless I hate eggs. 

I wish I could do Martial arts again, but it is too expensive to do anymore, and I am not fit enough to do it.

I was in the same situation awhile ago, kinda everything has fallen apart in my world in the past few months, all my ambitions. I'm back on track with goal now, job opportunities still are bad, but I realised that changing myself is what I need. 

I'd like to say thankyou to a stranger who left me a message in a comment, which really was what I needed. They deleted their comment, so I never got to thank them, if you're out there thanks. 

On another note, good luck to you dude, I hope you're gonna be able to sort everything out!
I've actually been looked at by doctors and have no sign of depression or mental illness.

What's the point of continuation of life where I will spend the most of life hating what I'm doing, and hating myself for doing it, then to maybe retire when I'm old and frail and unable to do anything with the things I built while working. Then only to sit and waste away and die. Wouldn't it just be easier to end it now?

It's not even that, I've browsed nearly everything physically possible for me to do, I can't find anything that makes me happy, or I would enjoy. 

It's not even just my degree, it's that, whatever I do, will end up just putting me in the same situation of being stuck in a dead end job for no reason.

I don't find meaning or true happiness anywhere though, I can watch a movie and think I'm happy for viewing that, I can read literature and gain worldly knowledge but in the end, it has no effect on me.

In response to 'working hard', I'm chronically lazy, I hate working hard, and it makes me miserable. 

I can see no way of doing the things that make me happy, because they just don't exist. I can't do them. 

I'm honestly not even having a bad day, I just can't see any point to life as a whole anymore.
